content.text: Chronic systemic, multi-organ autoimmune disorder of connective tissues
Primarily a type III hypersensitivity reaction (Ag-Ab immune complexes)
: CNS (HA, stroke, seizures), CV, glomerulonephritis, retinitis, oral ulcers, alopecia, serositis (pericarditis, pleuritis)
pericarditis w/ or w/o effusion is MC manifestation
palpable purpura, petechiae, papulonodular lesions, livedo reticularis, panniculitis, splinter hemorrhages, superficial ulcerations
– in the context of antiphospholipid antibodies
keratoconjunctivitis sicca MC manifestation as a result of secondary Sjogren’s syndrome
hematuria, proteinuria, nephrotic syndrome, glomerulonephritis, loss of renal function
esophagitis, intestinal pseudo-obstruction, protein-losing enteropathy, lupus hepatitis, acute pancreatitis, mesenteric vasculitis or ischemia, peritonitis
pleuritis (w/ or w/o effusion), pneumonitis, interstitial lung disease, pulmonary HTN, shrinking lung syndrome, alveolar hemorrhage
stroke, seizures, cognitive dysfunction, delirium, psychosis, peripheral neuropathies
Sunscreen & avoidance of prolonged sun exposure in all pts
high-dose steroids or intermittent IV “pulses” of methylprednisolone
– monoclonal antibody that inhibits B-lymphocyte stimulator binding to B cells, which inhibits B cell survival
unresponsive to steroids or other immunosuppressive agents
